title: The Gilded Garden Anew
author: Petra Blackwood
blurb: Noor Fairweather, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
